project.name: CommunityWatch™ Windows
project.description: Electron desktop client for CommunityWatch™ (lane: Windows App/)

version.instruction: Bump both together on every release build.

privacy.macAddresses: Never leave the app; LAN scan API returns anonymized deviceId (salted hash) plus IP.
privacy.defaultBark: Blind — no location, no category, no device payload.
privacy.optIn: Coarse country/region only; category from app classifier (no per-category UI).

lanDiscovery.probeLan: Optional ICMP sweep; off by default; may trigger home-router / AV alerts.
lanDiscovery.autoRefresh: User-triggered refresh + one passive pass on open; no periodic background LAN polling.

liveView.pcTcp: Established TCP on this PC only (OS socket table); not LAN-wide HTTPS decryption.
liveView.scrollBehavior: Pinned to newest at bottom unless user scrolls up; returning to bottom re-enables pinning.

updates.contract: GET returns application/json; body JSON with latestVersion|version|app_version and downloadUrl|installerUrl|url (GitHub asset URLs allowed).
updates.startupCheck: Packaged app checks ~2.8s after launch when settings.updates.checkOnStartup !== false.
updates.devCheck: Set env CW_UPDATE_CHECK_DEV=1 when running npm start to enable the same check.

buildAndRelease.dependencies: npm run deps — optional TLS: .certs/npm-extra-ca.pem (see scripts/TLS-README.txt)
buildAndRelease.publicStorefrontRepo: npm run release:public with PUBLIC_RELEASE_DIR=<clone of minimal public repo>; copies installer + SHA256 + README from scripts/public-release/README.md.template

securityNotes.electronWebPreferences: contextIsolation true, nodeIntegration false, sandbox true
securityNotes.packaged: Electron fuses via scripts/afterPack.cjs; menu stripped; devtools shortcuts blocked
securityNotes.downloadHosts: Updater only fetches installers from allowlisted HTTPS hosts (see main.js isTrustedDownloadUrl)

intelRules.future: Signed remote rules download — design notes in intel/README.md

cursorLanes.note: Parent monorepo may contain Website/ and other lanes; edits in this chat should stay under Windows App/ unless user asks otherwise.
